v3-beta-welcome.title: Welcome to the v3 beta
v3-beta-welcome.p1: We've made a backup of your database automatically, but making your own before you rely on the beta is never a bad idea. Data loss is not expected, but this is a beta, so it can happen.
v3-beta-welcome.p2: Please understand that this is a work in progress. There will be many style and functionality changes that happen very rapidly. When we change something, we've done it thoughtfully.
v3-beta-welcome.p3: We welcome suggestions, but we're already trying to contain our own scope-creep impulses. New features are unlikely to be added until after v3 is official.
v3-beta-welcome.p4: That said, we are very eager for bug reports, input on ergonomics, and feedback about what is confusing.
v3-beta-welcome.p5: We're very happy to entertain merge requests, but please first raise them as a feature request on Discord or GitLab so we can discuss it. Things are changing very rapidly behind the scenes and we want to avoid duplicated effort.

autoImport.title: Auto-Import
autoImport.description: Configure automatic book import from a directory
autoImport.explanation: Storyteller can be configured to automatically import book files from a specific directory. When enabled, Storyteller will set up a filesystem watcher for the directory and automatically import any new book files it finds.

autoImport.epub2BackupSuffixDescription: Added to the filename of the extra file these strategies create. {placeholder} is replaced with the EPUB version of that file, so the default {example} names the backup book_epub2.epub and the converted copy book_epub3.epub.

readaloud.cleanCacheAfterReadaloudDescription: Automatically delete processed audio, transcripts and alignment data after a readaloud is successfully created. Saves disk space, but means a full restart is needed if you want to re-align later.
readaloud.clearCacheNowDescription: Delete all processed audio, transcripts and alignment data across the library now. Original files are left untouched.
readaloud.clearCacheConfirmDescription: Delete processed audio, transcripts and alignment data for every book in the library? This frees disk space but means a full restart is needed to re-align books later. Original files are left untouched.

audio.title: Audio Settings
audio.maxTrackLengthDescription: Audio tracks longer than this will be split before transcribing. This can help reduce memory usage during transcription.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: Choose how Storyteller alignes the book text with the audiobook narration.

whisper.label: Whisper transcription
whisper.description: Transcribes the narration with Whisper, then matches that transcript to the book text.

ctc.label: CTC forced alignment (experimental)
ctc.description: Aligns the book text straight to the audio. It is more accurate, gives better word timings and works well across languages.

alignment.alignmentGranularityDescription: Word level alignment may not be accurately reproduces in all clients at the moment, and is only available with the CTC aligner.
alignment.whisperCppDescription: Runs directly on the server hosting Storyteller. No extra setup and nothing leaves this machine; speed depends on its hardware.
alignment.googleCloudDescription: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text. Paid cloud API; requires an API key.
alignment.microsoftAzureDescription: Azure AI speech recognition. Paid cloud API; requires a subscription key and service region.
alignment.amazonTranscribeDescription: AWS transcription via an S3 bucket. Paid cloud API; requires AWS credentials.
alignment.openaiCloudDescription: OpenAI's hosted transcription API. Also works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint via a custom base URL.
alignment.deepgramDescription: Deepgram's hosted speech-to-text API. Paid cloud API; requires an API key.
alignment.whisperBuildDeprecated: cuBLAS 11.8 is no longer supported. Please update to version 12 or 13.
alignment.whisperModelDescription: The default (tiny) is sufficient for most English books. For books with many uncommon words, or in languages other than English, you may need larger models like small or medium.
alignment.whisperThreadsDescription: Change the parallelization level of the Whisper model. Can result in a massive speed increase when doing GPU-accelerated transcription.
alignment.whisperThreadsNote: It is not recommended to set both this value and the "Number of audio tracks to transcribe in parallel" value to a value greater than 1. Choose one or the other.
alignment.whisperThreadsWarning: Setting above 1 may reduce transcription accuracy but increases speed by splitting audio into chunks processed in parallel. Do not report bugs if you set this to a value greater than 1 and are not able to get a consistent Readaloud, only if you cannot get a consistent Readaloud even with a value of 1.
alignment.whisperCpuFallbackDescription: If you have a GPU variant installed but want to fall back to CPU transcription, select a CPU variant here.
alignment.whisperServerUrlDescription: e.g. http://192.168.1.19:8080 for the local whisper.cpp server.
alignment.whisperServerApiKeyDescription: Only necessary if your server requires an API key.
alignment.whisperServerDescription: Offload transcription to a Ghost Story server running on another, faster machine. Any whisper.cpp-compatible server works too.
alignment.bucketNameDescription: Amazon Transcribe requires files to be uploaded to an S3 bucket before starting the transcribe job. This is the bucket Storyteller will upload files to.
alignment.baseUrlDescription: You can use a custom base URL to point at a OpenAI-compatible service like a self-hosted speaches instance or a remote whisper.cpp HTTP server.
alignment.modelNameDescription: e.g. Systran/faster-distil-whisper-large-v3 for faster-whisper-server, or whisper-1 for OpenAI Cloud.
alignment.deepgramModelDescription: Can be any model the server supports, like nova-3, nova-2, nova, enhanced, base or whisper. Defaults to nova-3.

parallelization.title: Parallelization Settings
parallelization.description: Audio transcoding is single-threaded, and Whisper has diminishing returns on multi-core processing for a single file. Since Storyteller splits input audio into multiple tracks, it can run transcoding and transcription in parallel.
parallelization.parallelTranscodesDescription: Transcoding one track will use one CPU core
parallelization.parallelTranscribesDescription: Transcribing one track will use up to 4 CPU cores (when using CPU-based transcription)
parallelization.parallelWhisperBuildDescription: Whenever the Storyteller container is recreated (e.g. after an update), it will rebuild whisper.cpp. This process can be sped up by dedicating multiple CPU cores.
